prompt: I want to write a blog post about how vibe coding is changing the software industry. Target audience is non-technical founders and business leaders. Around 1500 words. Make it compelling but grounded in real examples.

assertions.text: Produces at least 3 distinct draft versions with different tones/styles
Includes a Review Gate / direction approval step before drafting
Includes a fact-checking or review step that flags unverified claims
Provides multiple headline options for the final piece
Content is appropriate for non-technical founders (avoids jargon, uses business analogies)
Final output is approximately 1500 words (1200-1800 range)
